description: This file defines a custom React hook 'useLlmCostsHierarchy' that fetches hierarchical LLM cost data from a backend API endpoint, with support for filtering via URL parameters. It manages internal state for data, loading status, and errors, and exposes a refetch method.

methods.name: useLlmCostsHierarchy({ filter } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that fetches hierarchical LLM costs from a backend API, supporting optional filtering, and provides data, loading status, error, and refetch function.
